findings.source_passage: The abnormal mind is quick to detect and attach itself to this quality when it appears in a normal person, and so it came about that in college I was unjustly accused of being a politician
findings.source_locator: Paragraph 3, between father's advice and 'Reserving judgements'
findings.why_it_matters: This digression on college confidences and Nick's reputation as a 'politician' is a key voice-establishing passage that demonstrates Nick's ironic self-awareness and sets up his role as confessor to Gatsby; its removal flattens the narrator's consciousness between the father's advice and the 'infinite hope' sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'abnormal mind' through 'plagiaristic and marred by obvious suppressions' passage; it is the connective tissue that earns 'Reserving judgements is a matter of infinite hope.'

findings.source_passage: This responsiveness had nothing to do with that flabby impressionability which is dignified under the name of the 'creative temperament'—it was an extraordinary gift for hope
findings.source_locator: Paragraph 4 (Gatsby thesis paragraph), between 'earthquakes ten thousand miles away' and 'romantic readiness'
findings.why_it_matters: The contrast with 'flabby impressionability' and the 'creative temperament' dis­tinction is part of the critically load-bearing Gatsby thesis sentence; the draft drops it and splices directly to 'It was an extraordinary gift,' losing the rhetorical architecture that gives the passage its weight.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'This responsiveness had nothing to do with that flabby impressionability which is dignified under the name of the "creative temperament"—' as the bridge before 'it was an extraordinary gift for hope.'

findings.source_passage: A breeze blew through the room, blew curtains in at one end and out the other like pale flags, twisting them up toward the frosted wedding-cake of the ceiling, and then rippled over the wine-coloured rug
findings.source_locator: Buchanan interior scene, before the balloon-couch set-piece
findings.why_it_matters: The draft reproduces the curtain/rug image but drops 'twisting them up toward the frosted wedding-cake of the ceiling' — a prosodically distinctive phrase that is part of the famous floating-women set-piece; its loss flattens one of the novel's most celebrated atmospheric passages.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'twisting them up toward the frosted wedding-cake of the ceiling' within the curtain sentence.

findings.source_passage: It was the kind of voice that the ear follows up and down, as if each speech is an arrangement of notes that will never be played again… a singing compulsion, a whispered 'Listen,' a promise that she had done gay, exciting things just a while since and that there were gay, exciting things hovering in the next hour.
findings.source_locator: After Daisy laughs 'I'm p-paralysed with happiness', description of her voice
findings.why_it_matters: The draft preserves the 'arrangement of notes' clause and 'a whispered Listen' but excises 'a promise that she had done gay, exciting things just a while since and that there were gay, exciting things hovering in the next hour' — the forward-promise element that foreshadows 'her voice is full of money' and is critically indispensable to readings of Daisy's seductiveness.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full tail of the voice description through 'gay, exciting things hovering in the next hour.'

findings.source_passage: Conduct may be founded on the hard rock or the wet marshes, but after a certain point I don't care what it's founded on.
findings.source_locator: Opening section, paragraph immediately before the Gatsby thesis ('Only Gatsby…')
findings.why_it_matters: This sentence is the rhetorical pivot that earns Nick's exemption of Gatsby; without it the transition from 'my tolerance has a limit' to 'Only Gatsby was exempt' loses its logical and stylistic grounding, and a textually distinctive aphorism disappears.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'Conduct may be founded on the hard rock or the wet marshes, but after a certain point I don't care what it's founded on' before the 'Only Gatsby' sentence.

findings.source_passage: the lawn started at the beach and ran towards the front door for a quarter of a mile, jumping over sundials and brick walks and burning gardens—finally when it reached the house drifting up the side in bright vines as though from the momentum of its run
findings.source_locator: Arrival at the Buchanan house, exterior description
findings.why_it_matters: This kinetic lawn description is stylistically distinctive Fitzgerald prose and establishes the excess and forward momentum that characterise East Egg; its absence mildly flattens the approach to the house.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the lawn sentence in the Buchanan exterior paragraph; it is short enough to add without budget strain.

findings.source_passage: I bought a dozen volumes on banking and credit and investment securities, and they stood on my shelf in red and gold like new money from the mint
findings.source_locator: Nick's West Egg paragraph, after 'life was beginning over again with the summer'
findings.why_it_matters: The draft retains this line, which is tagged optional — no loss. Noted for completeness only.

summary: The draft preserves all verbatim signatures intact but accumulates four medium-severity failures — the college-politician voice digression, the 'flabby impressionability / creative temperament' bridge in the Gatsby thesis, the 'hard rock or wet marshes' pivot, and the tail of Daisy's voice description — which together constitute sufficient voice erasure and interpretive loss to require a regeneration pass.
